qs.q: When taking a structured preconception medical history, the clinician must ask about haematological disorders. Which of the following conditions is specifically highlighted in the note for preconception screening?
o: Polycythaemia vera and acquired aplastic anaemia disorders
Immune thrombocytopenic purpura and haemophilia B disorders
Sickle-cell disease and thalassaemia blood disorders
Factor V Leiden deficiency and protein C excess
qs.e: Sickle-cell disease and thalassaemia are specifically noted among the haematological disorders to evaluate during medical history taking. The other conditions are either less common or not explicitly emphasized in this context.
